svg.title: A single streaming turn through the ReAct loop
svg.desc: The loop takes the run queue for the thread, clears any stale abort flag, and renders history through the session strategy. Each step compacts if the window demands it, calls the model, and either finishes or runs the tool batch. A context overflow is retried exactly once, and only while nothing has been streamed to the client, because a client that has already rendered deltas cannot un-render them. After the batch the loop drains steering messages, so a user can redirect a run between tool calls without starting a new turn. Every model response and tool result is appended to the session log whether or not display events were emitted.
svg.text: quarantine truncated calls, never run them
tool results, fatal flag, terminate flag
